Atmore Community Hospital

49 Beds
Acute Care Hospitals
ATMORE, AL
Part of Infirmary Health
Current ERP: Microsoft
Version: NA
There is evidence suggesting Atmore Community Hospital may be using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for financial accounting, but further confirmation is needed as another source indicates an Oracle ERP implementation instead.

Based on the search results, here’s what I found regarding Atmore Community Hospital and Microsoft ERP systems:

  • Possible Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Use: A search result from Malakye lists a person as being responsible for financial accounting entries under Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central at Atmore Community Hospital as of April 2020 [2].
  • Security Program for Rural Hospitals: Atmore Community Hospital is listed as one of the hospitals participating in the Security Program for Rural Hospitals [4]. This program is associated with Microsoft and mentions Azure adoption, but it doesn’t directly indicate the hospital using Dynamics 365 as its ERP.
  • Statement of Work: Atmore Community Hospital appears in a document related to a statement of work for Envision ERP Implementation [3]. However, the ERP mentioned in this document is Oracle. This indicates that Atmore Community Hospital may have had an Oracle ERP implementation project with Envision Healthcare Corporation.
  • USF Muma College of Business Alumni Notes: Notes from USF Muma College of Business mention that Sherry Winczewski was promoted to practice administrator for three physician practices of Atmore Community Hospital [8]. This doesn’t relate to ERP usage, but confirms details about the hospital.

It’s important to note that there’s a potential conflict in the information. One source indicates possible use of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, while another points towards Oracle ERP. It is possible that the hospital uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for accounting, while using Oracle for their EMR/Hospital ERP.

Therefore, based on the search results, there’s a hint that Atmore Community Hospital might be using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Further investigation is needed to confirm this and the context in which it’s being used.

Aurora Behavioral Health System Tempe

138 Beds
Psychiatric
TEMPE, AZ
Part of Signature Healthcare Services
Current ERP: Microsoft
Version: NA
There is no direct evidence that Aurora Behavioral Health System Tempe is using Microsoft for its EHR, although Signature HealthCARE, its parent company, utilizes Microsoft Dynamics GP for financial management.

Based on my research, here’s what I found regarding Aurora Behavioral Health System Tempe and Microsoft ERP systems:

Signature HealthCARE and Microsoft Dynamics GP:

  • Several sources indicate that Signature HealthCARE, the parent company of Aurora Behavioral Health System Tempe, uses Microsoft Dynamics GP.
  • A case study highlights that Signature HealthCARE saved $120,000 a year by scaling from 55 to 239 entities using Microsoft Dynamics GP. (January 7, 2025)
  • Signature HealthCARE operated over 55 unique entities, each with a separate database, all within Microsoft Dynamics GP.
  • Binary Stream offers add-on solutions to expand Dynamics GP capabilities, with Signature HealthCARE as a customer.

Aurora Behavioral Health and EHR Systems:

  • A research study mentions that Aurora behavioral hospitals (including Aurora Tempe) decided to implement a behavioral EHR system in 2017 by customizing a commercial EHR system. The specific EHR system isn’t named but was supported by Seoul National University Bundang Hospital (SNUBH).
  • ezCaretech lists Aurora Behavioral Health System, LLC (aka Glendale) and Aurora Behavioral Healthcare - Tempe, LLC (aka Tempe) as clients, suggesting they may use ezCaretech’s EHR.

Signature HealthCARE and Other Microsoft Technologies:

  • Signature Healthcare has purchased Microsoft Azure Cloud Services for application hosting and computing services in 2020.
  • Signature Performance, which appears to be affiliated, uses TriZetto Facets hosted in the Microsoft Azure Government Cloud. (April 2, 2025)

Key Takeaways:

  • While Aurora Behavioral Health System Tempe is part of Signature Healthcare, it appears Signature Healthcare uses Microsoft Dynamics GP, particularly for financial management across its many entities.
  • Aurora Behavioral Health System Tempe implemented a behavioral EHR system in 2017, but the specific product is not identified as a Microsoft product in the search results.
  • There’s no direct evidence in the search results that Aurora Behavioral Health System Tempe uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 as its hospital ERP system. It’s more likely that the parent company utilizes Dynamics GP for financial management and that Aurora Tempe uses a different EHR system (possibly ezCaretech) for clinical data.

It’s important to note that hospital systems often have different solutions for financial management (ERP) and patient data (EHR), so the use of Dynamics GP by Signature Healthcare doesn’t automatically mean Aurora Tempe uses a Microsoft clinical system.

There is evidence that Greater El Monte Community Hospital has used Microsoft ERP systems, specifically Dynamics GP and Dynamics NAV, based on a job posting and a training document from 2019.

Based on my search results, here’s what I found regarding Greater El Monte Community Hospital and Microsoft ERP systems:

  • Dynamics GP: A job posting for an Assistant Controller at AHMC Healthcare, the parent company of Greater El Monte Community Hospital, mentions experience with Dynamics GP, among other ERP systems. This suggests that AHMC Healthcare, and possibly Greater El Monte Community Hospital, may utilize Dynamics GP.
  • Dynamics NAV: A document from 2019 mentions “Greater El Monte Community Hospital LP, dba Greater El Monte Community Hospital” and training related to “Dynamics NAV 2017.” This strongly indicates that the hospital was using Dynamics NAV 2017 as their ERP system at that time.

I did not find any evidence of Greater El Monte Community Hospital using Microsoft Dynamics 365.

Ridgecrest Regional Hospital

25 Beds
Critical Access Hospitals
RIDGECREST, CA
Independent
Current ERP: Microsoft
Version: NA
Ridgecrest Regional Hospital utilizes Microsoft products through its Paragon Denali EHR, which is built on Microsoft Azure and uses a Microsoft SQL database, along with the use of Office 365.

Based on the search results, here’s what I found regarding Ridgecrest Regional Hospital and its IT systems:

  • Paragon Denali EHR: Ridgecrest Regional Hospital has a 25-year partnership with Paragon (Altera Digital Health) and uses their Paragon Denali EHR. The Altera Digital Health website states that the Paragon Denali EHR is architected and deployed on the Microsoft Azure platform and uses a Microsoft SQL database. The ERP component of Paragon Denali is designed for community hospitals, and covers General Ledger, Payroll, Fixed Assets, Materials Management, Accounts Payable, and Webstation for Executives.
  • Mitel MiVoice Business: Since 2018, Ridgecrest Regional Hospital has been modernizing its communication systems with Mitel MiVoice Business.
  • Alertus Mass Notification System: Following earthquakes in 2019, Ridgecrest Regional Hospital implemented Alertus’ Desktop Notification and Mobile App solutions for emergency communication.
  • Microsoft Products: A job posting mentions familiarity with Office 365, SQL, and VoIP.

Summary:

While Ridgecrest Regional Hospital doesn’t appear to be using Microsoft Dynamics 365 for its core ERP functions, there is evidence that it uses Microsoft products in other areas:

  • The Paragon Denali EHR system they use is built on Microsoft Azure and uses Microsoft SQL.
  • They use Office 365.
